easy.description: Accessible, intuitive, and practical paper with minimal mathematical complexity and maximum conceptual clarity.
math_guidelines: Limit formulations to standard algebra, basic arithmetic, and high-level conceptual equations.
Explain every equation in plain language immediately following its presentation.
Avoid multi-page theorem-proof blocks; replace with intuitive rationale and flow diagrams.
empirical_guidelines: Include 1-2 standard benchmark evaluations or intuitive case studies.
Present clear comparative tables with highlighted best performers.
Focus on practical implications, straightforward trade-offs, and usability.
easy.target_readership: Undergraduate students, practitioners, cross-disciplinary readers, and general engineers.
easy.tone: Pedagogical, lucid, transparent, direct, and completely free of unnecessary jargon.

medium.description: Standard high-quality conference or journal paper (IEEE/ACM/Elsevier caliber) with rigorous methodology and balanced math.
math_guidelines: Include formal problem formulation with explicit notation, input/output spaces, and objective functions.
Provide step-by-step algorithmic formulation with pseudo-code and parameter definitions.
Use formal definitions for core concepts.
empirical_guidelines: Evaluate against 3-5 established baselines on standard benchmark datasets or simulation regimes.
Report standard deviations / confidence intervals across at least 3-5 random seeds.
Conduct systematic ablation studies isolating the contribution of each key component.
Include statistical significance tests (e.g., paired t-test or Wilcoxon signed-rank test).
medium.target_readership: Graduate researchers, domain specialists, and conference peer reviewers.
medium.tone: Scholarly, evidence-tied, neutral, objective, and structured.

hard.description: Top-tier conference / premier journal paper (NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, IEEE TPAMI) featuring deep theoretical derivations and extensive empirical validation.
math_guidelines: Formulate formal Theorems, Lemmas, Propositions, and Corollaries with complete proofs.
Derive theoretical bounds (e.g., convergence rates, sample complexity, generalization bounds, or Lyapunov stability).
Include rigorous asymptotic complexity analysis (Big-O, Omega, Theta).
empirical_guidelines: Comprehensive multi-benchmark comparison against all state-of-the-art baselines.
Extensive ablation studies exploring hyperparameters, sensitivity, scalability, and extreme edge conditions.
Full error-budget analysis and failure mode characterization.
hard.target_readership: Leading researchers, theoretical specialists, and senior program committee members.
hard.tone: Deeply technical, uncompromisingly rigorous, mathematically exact, and analytical.

extreme.description: Ultimate tier research paper (Nature, Science, STOC/FOCS, Breakthrough caliber) offering novel foundational paradigms and exhaustive theoretical proofs.
math_guidelines: Introduce novel mathematical formulations or theoretical paradigms that resolve open problems.
Provide exhaustive formal mathematical proofs from first principles, included in a rigorous dedicated Appendix.
Establish both upper and lower bounds, min-max optimality, or topological/measure-theoretic foundations.
empirical_guidelines: Massive-scale empirical validation or comprehensive high-dimensional simulation regimes.
Empirical confirmation of theoretical asymptotic rates under varying conditions.
Cross-domain stress testing and exhaustive sensitivity analysis over multiple orders of magnitude.
extreme.target_readership: World-leading scientific authorities, fellowship committees, and journal editors-in-chief.
extreme.tone: Foundational, monumental, authoritative, yet written with crystal-clear intuition before formal mechanics.
